subject: Re: MicroVendor pilot — alternate approval path for invoices during trial
messages:
From: Mira Sanchez <mira@microvendor.co>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Trial onboarding + PO question

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — were excited to run the 30-day pilot with Redwood. Our finance team is tiny and they asked whether we can onboard and bill via invoice without a Redwood PO for the pilot period. Typical invoices will be under $1,500.

Can you confirm if theres an existing trial exception for small vendors or if we need an active PO to proceed? If helpful, I attached a completed vendor onboarding form and a short vendor profile.

Best,
Mira Sanchez
Head of Ops, MicroVendor Ltd.
attachments: microvendor_onboarding_form.pdf, risk_profile_mini.xlsx

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Mira Sanchez <mira@microvendor.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding + PO question

Hi Mira —

Thanks for the form and context. Short answer: our standard procurement policy requires a PO for any vendor engagement, but we do have a temporary invoice-only pathway for low-dollar pilots when certain risk checks are satisfied and Finance signs off.

Next steps I need from you to evaluate:
- Confirmation that total pilot spend will be <= $2,000
- W-9 (or equivalent) and confirmation of legal entity name
- Clarify billing address and remit-to email

Im copying Marissa and Vivek so theyre aware of the sales commitment; once Finance (Naomi) confirms the temporary path we can route a one-time approval. Ill also note this on the HubSpot deal.

If youre able to send the W-9, I can run the quick risk check and keep things moving.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0193
attachments: (none)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Mira Sanchez <mira@microvendor.co>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding + PO question

Adding context from the AE side: MicroVendor is the small integration partner for our Search Connectors pilot. The commercial ask is straightforward — 30-day pilot, single seat usage, total expected invoice $1,200. Well need them live this week if possible to meet our buyers needs.

Proposed compromise: allow invoice-only onboarding for the pilot under $2k with the condition that MicroVendor signs the standard SOW addendum and we place them on a 90-day watchlist (review after pilot). Finance gets a copy of the invoices and Marissa will approve them in HubSpot.

If Procurement can confirm this temporary path, Ill get the SOW signed today.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-23T14:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding + PO question

Thanks for the thread. Finances position: prefer PO-backed engagements for vendor controls, but we can approve a one-off invoice-only flow for pilots meeting these constraints:
- Pilot spend cap <= $2,000 total (one invoice)
- Vendor passes the quick risk profile (legal entity verified, tax form on file)
- Sales commits to hold payment until Finance receives invoice and completes PO waiver entry in our system

If Procurement confirms the waiver, Finance will:
1) Create a temporary vendor token and payment method;
2) Record the waiver in our procurement ledger (GL code and waiver reference);
3) Require Marissa to upload invoices to the HubSpot deal and tag the reimbursement code.

Ive attached the mini risk checklist used for quick approvals (risk_profile_mini.xlsx). If everything checks out I can provision the temporary route this afternoon.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: risk_profile_mini.xlsx

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Mira Sanchez <mira@microvendor.co>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-24T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding + PO question — TEMP APPROVAL GRANTED

Hi Mira —

Good news: Finance has approved a temporary invoice-only onboarding for the MicroVendor pilot under the conditions outlined below. Please confirm and return the requested artifacts so we can finalize today:

Conditions for temporary approval:
- Total pilot spend must be <= $2,000 (single invoice)
- Signed SOW addendum for the pilot (Marissa will send the DocuSign link)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form on file (send to accounts@redwood.ai)
- MicroVendor agrees to a 90-day review at the end of the pilot and to provide basic usage metrics upon request

Actions we have taken:
- Naomi has provisioned a temporary vendor token pending documents
- Ive recorded a procurement waiver and uploaded it to the deal (HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890)
- Marissa: please send the DocuSign SOW addendum and tag the invoice when you upload it to HubSpot

Mira — please reply to confirm you accept the conditions and attach the W-9. Well kick off the pilot once those items are received.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
